Headquarters: Remote 

Lithic is the modern card issuing and processing platform empowering ambitious financial companies to build the future of payments.

Our infrastructure powers card programs for 100+ innovative clients, from fintechs reimagining credit and digital banking to platforms transforming disbursements and spend management. Companies like Mercury, Flex, and Novo rely on Lithic's developer-friendly APIs, direct network connections, and flawless reconciliation to launch and scale card programs in weeks, not years.

We're building a future where access to better financial products materially improves people's lives, free from the constraints of 30-year-old mainframes and legacy processors. We're proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Stripes, and Mastercard, along with many others. 

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. 
Reporting to Sam Pinsak, Privacy’s Product Lead, who oversees both product and marketing, you'll partner closely with your engineering manager, eng lead, and the engineers on your pod, a product designer, and, depending on the work, leads across risk, payment, and dispute ops, compliance, biz ops, and support. The product team is small, senior, and moves fast. This is a hands-on role: you'll own a broad surface and live in the details — writing the specs, pulling the data you need to make a call, staying close to customers, and sitting in planning and grooming with your engineering squad. You're self-sufficient with data day to day and partner with an analyst on the deeper dives, and you lean on AI tooling to do the work of a much bigger team. Every bet ties back to the P&L, scope gets cut hard, and you'll have a short path to the CEO and to real customers.

What You’ll Do:

• Own the roadmap and strategy for a core product surface

• Own the surface and its year-long roadmap; keep the whole thing moving while going deep where it counts most right now

• Pick the right problems across that surface and frame them into testable bets with clear outcomes; set the product vision and strategy

• Act as the default decision-maker for your surface and make cross-area trade-offs; defend your calls under ambiguity at leadership review

• Drive decisions with data and deep customer + business understanding

• Own the metrics that roll directly into financial and business outcomes for your surface; know which levers move them and which to pull first to hit a target

• Reason in contribution-margin and unit-economics terms, not just feature impact; hold a segment-level model of our customers and spearhead the research that resolves high-impact, ambiguous questions

• Build the dashboards and success metrics other teams adopt, and use data to drive cross-functional buy-in

• Lead the team and work cross-functionally

• Lead an engineering squad as its product manager, and influence cross-functional teams to re-prioritize toward your roadmap

• Turn recurring decisions into playbooks the team reuses; push for configurable systems and AI/tooling patterns that lift the whole team, not just you

• Communicate clearly from the detail level up to the strategic picture, adapting to your audience; mentor other PMs and raise the team's craft bar

What You’ll Bring:

• Ownership of a product area (or multiple connected areas) end-to-end and set its strategy — not just execution of a roadmap handed to you

• Demonstrate strong judgment under ambiguity: you pick the right problems, make defensible calls, and know when to walk away from one

• Fluent in unit economics and how product decisions move the P&L

• Ability to find the levers that matter in performance data and turn them into a clear story for non-technical audiences

• Fluent with AI-assisted tools and actively building with them to multiply your own and the team's output

• Ability to ramp quickly across unfamiliar domains and get to real depth quickly

• Consumer or D2C product experience; consumer fintech or payments a strong plus, not a requirement

• Ability to operate autonomously, with strong communication skills, ruthless about scope without sacrificing quality, and humble

The annual US salary range for this role is $168,000 - $225,000 plus equity. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Lithic and will be narrowed during the interview process based on the candidate’s experience and qualifications. 

This is a remote position. However, candidates must be located in the United States. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance.

ROLE SUMMARY
The GenAI Platform Engineering team builds and runs the shared platform that lets Pfizer colleagues and applications use generative AI safely and at scale. At its core is the enterprise GenAI Gateway: a single, governed entry point to large language models from multiple providers, with self-service access, routing, usage and cost transparency, and observability built in. Around it, we deliver evaluation, observability and agentic tooling — MCP integrations, agent registries and reusable agent skills — for teams across the company.
We run the platform as a product: self-service over tickets, automation over manual approvals, small and frequent releases, and reliability we can measure. We are looking for a hands-on engineer to help evolve the Gateway and its ecosystem. You will keep it secure, fast and current in a fast-moving open-source landscape. You will work closely with a globally distributed team and with the teams that build on the platform.
This is an individual contributor role.
ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES
Platform engineering

• Design, build and operate features of the enterprise LLM gateway, mainly in Python:

• multi-provider model access

• routing and failover

• API key and access management

• budgets, usage metering and chargeback

• Integrate agentic capabilities into the platform with the right security controls. Examples include Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tool calling across providers, and agent-to-agent connectivity.

• Keep the platform’s open-source foundations current. Assess upstream releases, maintain and retire Pfizer-specific extensions, and deliver upgrades without regressions.

• Contribute to the platform’s admin and self-service experiences, including web UI, portals and developer documentation.

Quality, reliability and security

• Build and maintain automated quality gates in CI/CD. These include unit, integration, contract and performance/load tests that protect every release.

• Instrument services with metrics, traces and logs (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Langfuse). Use them to find and fix latency, error and cost issues.

• Take part in the support/on-call rotation. Lead root-cause analysis of production incidents, and turn the findings into lasting fixes and blameless postmortems.

• Apply secure-by-default engineering:

• identity and access controls (SSO, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, RBAC)

• secret handling

• dependency pinning and supply-chain hygiene

Enablement and collaboration

• Evaluate emerging GenAI capabilities hands-on, such as model routing, guardrails and agent registries. Turn the results into clear recommendations on whether to adopt them.

• Help consuming teams onboard and succeed. Write guides and runbooks, and create reusable assets such as code samples and AI agent skills.

• Work in the open. Make InnerSource contributions, review code, and engage with open-source communities and vendors by reporting issues and proposing fixes upstream.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Applications, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 9+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building GenAI/LLM-based applications or platforms used in production.

• Strong Python skills for backend services: async programming, FastAPI or similar, REST APIs and streaming responses.

• Hands-on experience with LLM provider APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock), including tool/function calling and integrating multiple providers.

• Experience delivering and running services on AWS with containers and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Docker, GitHub Actions), with automated testing built into the workflow.

• Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and perform root-cause analysis.

• Clear written and verbal communication in English, and comfort working with distributed, cross-functional teams.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with an AI/LLM gateway or API gateway, including routing, key management and cost tracking.

• Experience running and extending open-source software in production, including patches, upgrades, regression testing and upstream contributions.

• Knowledge of agentic AI patterns and tooling:

• MCP

• LangGraph/LangChain or similar frameworks

• multi-agent orchestration

• RAG and vector search

• Experience with performance/load testing and observability tooling (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Prometheus/Grafana).

• Experience with Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

• Frontend skills (React, TypeScript) for internal tools and portals.

• Daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) and interest in building reusable agent skills.

• Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare or other regulated environments.

• Experience mentoring engineers or delivering technical enablement, such as workshops, documentation and onboarding.

• AWS certification.

WORK SCHEDULE

• Regular collaboration with colleagues in European time zones.

• Participation in the team’s support rotation.

An overview of this role

As a Senior CX Platform Engineer, you'll help GitLab's Customer Experience (CX) teams hand real work to artificial intelligence (AI). You'll use Claude Code and GitLab Duo Agent Platform as your default development tools, designing agentic workflows and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers with production testing, security, and shared ownership. What you'll do

  • Use Claude Code, GitLab Duo, and other coding agents as your primary development environment for planning, implementation, refactoring, testing, reviews, and documentation. Run multiple agents in parallel on well-scoped tasks, critically review their output, and own every line that reaches production.
  • Build and maintain the team's agent harness, including shared AGENTS.md conventions, skills, slash commands, hooks, subagent definitions, and continuous integration checks. Measure and share what works, publish reusable patterns, and retire those that don't.

Own applications such as PS Compass, Congregate, and GitLab University and its integrations, documenting build-versus-buy and consolidate-or-sunset decisions.
  • Ship production-quality Python and TypeScript through GitLab continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), with tests, observability, security review, and runbooks. Design every application for handoff, with documentation, monitoring, and shared ownership.
  • Prototype with Customer Success, Digital Success, Professional Services, Education Services, and Training in days, not quarters. Help CX team members bring their own applications to production, and turn field learning into reusable reference implementations, development paths, and enablement.
  • Contribute upstream to GitLab and share product feedback with Product and Engineering. Mentor engineers and non-engineers on agentic development and raise the team's code review bar.

  • Daily, hands-on use of coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, GitLab Duo, or similar on production work. You can show how they've changed what you ship and how you maintain quality.

  • Hands-on experience with AWS ECS, RDS, and Lambda, Terraform, Docker, and applications running behind single sign-on (SSO), such as Okta.
  • Experience integrating enterprise systems through Representational State Transfer (REST) and GraphQL APIs, and fluency with Git, merge requests, and CI/CD.
  • Experience translating non-engineering stakeholders' workflows into technical plans and writing clear asynchronous design documents, decision records, and enablement materials. You align with GitLab's values and are willing to use GitLab for your own work.
  • Optional experience includes agent harness customization; the GitLab Development Kit, Duo Agent Platform custom agents and flows, or AI Catalog publishing; enterprise agent governance and data controls; customer success, professional services, or learning platforms such as Salesforce, Gainsight, Kantata, or Thought Industries; professional services economics and customer success metrics; Snowflake or similar warehouses; and technical writing, talks, or open source contributions on agentic development.

About Us
Build the future of banking.
Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.
 
Our Impact and Growth
Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Backed by SoftBank Vision Fund, Mastercard, and other reputed strategic investors, we reached a valuation of $2 billion in Jan 1, 2025.
Our Product Lines
Our focus is on establishing product lines that focus on key outcomes by addressing real customer pain points, modernizing legacy systems, and strengthening core fundamentals. As a result, our systems and platforms support a wide range of banking and payments capabilities, including:
 
1. Tachyon, our cloud-native banking stack built for population-scale systems
2. Cipher, our unified authentication platform for secure, high-volume banking environments
3. Digital Credit as a Service, enabling banks to launch credit lines on UPI
4. Elena, our intelligent and conversational AI platform for banking
5. Pixel, India’s first digital-native credit card, launched in partnership with HDFC Bank, for whom we also revamped their PayZapp mobile app: Winner of the Celent Model Bank Award for Payments Innovation 2024
6. Sparrow, the leading card experience for non-prime cardholders in the US
…and more across cards, payments, lending, and core banking.
Our Culture and Values
We are an engineering-first organization that values ownership, bias for action, and long-term thinking. Together, we solve some of the hardest problems in banking tech. Our culture is built around trust, collaboration, and creating the conditions for you to drive impact proportionate to your potential. Reinforcing our commitment to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace, we have been consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work.
If you want to build cutting-edge banking tech that enables banks to serve millions reliably, securely, and at a population scale, Zeta is your playground.
Learn More About Zeta
If you would like to learn more about how we have grown and evolved over the years, watch our journey here. You can also explore our website and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram,YouTube, and X.
About the Role
The incumbent will be part of Zeta’s talent management CoE. The individual will be expected to contribute towards building the overall talent strategy at Zeta and ensuring its translation into meaningful programs and initiatives that shape the employee experience. A key focus of the role is to work on initiatives across talent planning, career development, performance management, competency creation and engagement with the People Success team to create a culture focused on unparalleled learning and career growth.


Responsibilities
Career architecture and competencies

• Design job families, levels, career ladders and levelling criteria.

• Build functional and leadership competency frameworks with behavioural indicators for each level.

• Redesign the architecture when roles or structures change.

Performance management

• Design and run the full performance cycle: goals (OKRs or KPIs), check-ins, reviews and calibration.

• Link performance outcomes to promotions, rewards and development.

Talent reviews and succession

• Design and run regular talent reviews that assess employees on both performance and potential.

• Identify high-potential employees, critical talent and retention risks across the organisation.

• Identify critical roles and build succession plans for them, with successors mapped by how ready they are.

• Design development plans for successors and high-potential employees.

• Track pipeline health through bench strength, successor readiness and internal fill rates.

Organisational change and design

• Assess the impact of restructures on roles, levels and career paths.

• Design and run the people side of each transition.

Talent strategy and analytics

• Build the talent strategy and the annual talent calendar.

• Track talent metrics: performance distribution, internal mobility, bench strength and regretted attrition.

Skills
• 

Strong analytical and data interpretation skills.

• 

Proficiency in HRIS platforms such as Darwinbox, Workday, or SuccessFactors.

• 

Strong understanding of talent management and organisational development practices.

Experience & Qualification
• 

MBA in Human Resources or a related field.

• 

6–8 years of experience in Talent Management or Organisational Development, preferably in a Consulting, Technology, or Fintech organisation.

• 

Hands-on experience in designing career architecture, competency frameworks, and performance management systems.

• 

Experience in talent reviews, succession planning, and organisational change.
